title: agk monitor (history)
description: What each stage cost, with drill-down from a stage to issues, launches and steps (issue #285). Numbers and text only.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT project FROM (SELECT project FROM launches UNION SELECT project FROM steps UNION SELECT project FROM cases) WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project
list.definition: SELECT project FROM (SELECT project FROM launches UNION SELECT project FROM steps UNION SELECT project FROM cases) WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project

list.name: stage
list.label: Stage
list.query: SELECT stage FROM (SELECT stage FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}') WHERE stage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stage DESC
list.definition: SELECT stage FROM (SELECT stage FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}') WHERE stage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stage DESC

list.name: issue
list.label: Issue
list.query: SELECT label FROM (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS label, MIN(issue IS NULL) AS o, MIN(issue) AS n FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) GROUP BY label) ORDER BY o, n
list.definition: SELECT label FROM (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS label, MIN(issue IS NULL) AS o, MIN(issue) AS n FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) GROUP BY label) ORDER BY o, n

list.name: launch
list.label: Launch
list.query: WITH k AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, ':' || model || ':' || CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS sfx FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), l AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(launch, CASE WHEN role = 'orchestrator' AND substr(id, 1, length(project) + 1) = project || ':' AND substr(id, -length(sfx)) = sfx THEN substr(id, length(project) + 2, length(id) - length(project) - 1 - length(sfx)) END) AS step_launch FROM k) SELECT step_launch FROM l WHERE issue_label = '${issue}' AND step_launch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY step_launch ORDER BY MIN(start_s), step_launch
list.definition: WITH k AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, ':' || model || ':' || CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS sfx FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), l AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(launch, CASE WHEN role = 'orchestrator' AND substr(id, 1, length(project) + 1) = project || ':' AND substr(id, -length(sfx)) = sfx THEN substr(id, length(project) + 2, length(id) - length(project) - 1 - length(sfx)) END) AS step_launch FROM k) SELECT step_launch FROM l WHERE issue_label = '${issue}' AND step_launch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY step_launch ORDER BY MIN(start_s), step_launch

panels.title: Stages
panels.description: Source: the run record (`launches`); lines with role `issue` are not launches. One row per provider: Claude and Codex are never added together. Weighted tokens are an estimate from price ratios. Orchestrator estimate lines are a row of their own (`orchestrator estimate`), never in the measured totals. The planner /stage-start session (role planner, no issue) is left out. A running stage shows the run-record lines written so far: Codex lines per attempt, Claude lines only after the stage-end `run_record.py write`. Time: the sum of the launch seconds. Retries: the retry cases of the stage; escalations: the cases with a `## ... NEEDS OWNER` marker (per stage, on each measured row). Click a row to see its issues.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH l AS (SELECT stage, provider, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, weighted, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, seconds FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS retries, SUM(escalation) AS escalations FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}' GROUP BY stage) SELECT l.stage, l.provider, l.lines, ROUND(SUM(l.weighted)) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, SUM(l.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(l.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(l.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(l.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, ROUND(SUM(l.seconds)) AS seconds, COUNT(*) AS launches, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.retries), 0) END AS retries, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.escalations), 0) END AS escalations FROM l LEFT JOIN c ON c.stage = l.stage GROUP BY l.stage, l.provider, l.lines ORDER BY l.stage DESC, l.provider, l.lines
targets.queryText: WITH l AS (SELECT stage, provider, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, weighted, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, seconds FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS retries, SUM(escalation) AS escalations FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}' GROUP BY stage) SELECT l.stage, l.provider, l.lines, ROUND(SUM(l.weighted)) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, SUM(l.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(l.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(l.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(l.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, ROUND(SUM(l.seconds)) AS seconds, COUNT(*) AS launches, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.retries), 0) END AS retries, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.escalations), 0) END AS escalations FROM l LEFT JOIN c ON c.stage = l.stage GROUP BY l.stage, l.provider, l.lines ORDER BY l.stage DESC, l.provider, l.lines

panels.title: Issues of the stage
panels.description: Source: the run record (`launches`); lines with role `issue` are not launches. One row per provider: Claude and Codex are never added together. Weighted tokens are an estimate from price ratios. Orchestrator estimate lines are a row of their own (`orchestrator estimate`), never in the measured totals. The planner /stage-start session (role planner, no issue) is left out. A running stage shows the run-record lines written so far: Codex lines per attempt, Claude lines only after the stage-end `run_record.py write`. The orchestrator lines (no issue) are the row `orchestrator`. A title is known only for the sub-issues of an open stage; else it is empty. Retries and escalations per issue. Click a row to see its launches.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH l AS (SELECT issue, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, provider, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, weighted, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, seconds FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), c AS (SELECT issue, COUNT(*) AS retries, SUM(escalation) AS escalations FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) GROUP BY issue) SELECT l.issue_label AS issue, COALESCE(MAX(i.title), '') AS title, l.provider, l.lines, ROUND(SUM(l.weighted)) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, SUM(l.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(l.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(l.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(l.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, ROUND(SUM(l.seconds)) AS seconds, COUNT(*) AS launches, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.retries), 0) END AS retries, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.escalations), 0) END AS escalations FROM l LEFT JOIN c ON c.issue = l.issue LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = '${project}' AND i.issue = l.issue GROUP BY l.issue_label, l.provider, l.lines ORDER BY MAX(l.issue IS NULL), MIN(l.issue), l.provider, l.lines
targets.queryText: WITH l AS (SELECT issue, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, provider, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, weighted, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, seconds FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), c AS (SELECT issue, COUNT(*) AS retries, SUM(escalation) AS escalations FROM cases WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) GROUP BY issue) SELECT l.issue_label AS issue, COALESCE(MAX(i.title), '') AS title, l.provider, l.lines, ROUND(SUM(l.weighted)) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, SUM(l.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(l.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(l.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(l.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, ROUND(SUM(l.seconds)) AS seconds, COUNT(*) AS launches, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.retries), 0) END AS retries, CASE WHEN l.lines = 'measured' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.escalations), 0) END AS escalations FROM l LEFT JOIN c ON c.issue = l.issue LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = '${project}' AND i.issue = l.issue GROUP BY l.issue_label, l.provider, l.lines ORDER BY MAX(l.issue IS NULL), MIN(l.issue), l.provider, l.lines

panels.title: Launches of the issue
panels.description: Source: the run record (`launches`); lines with role `issue` are not launches. One row per provider: Claude and Codex are never added together. Weighted tokens are an estimate from price ratios. Orchestrator estimate lines are a row of their own (`orchestrator estimate`), never in the measured totals. The planner /stage-start session (role planner, no issue) is left out. A running stage shows the run-record lines written so far: Codex lines per attempt, Claude lines only after the stage-end `run_record.py write`. The run-record lines of the chosen issue (`orchestrator`: the lines with no issue), in start order. `launch` is the launch of the step rows; `steps` their number. Click a row to see its steps.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH k AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, ':' || model || ':' || CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS sfx FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), l AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(launch, CASE WHEN role = 'orchestrator' AND substr(id, 1, length(project) + 1) = project || ':' AND substr(id, -length(sfx)) = sfx THEN substr(id, length(project) + 2, length(id) - length(project) - 1 - length(sfx)) END) AS step_launch FROM k) SELECT l.start_time AS start, l.issue_label AS issue, l.role, l.provider, l.model, l.lines, l.retry, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, ROUND(l.seconds) AS seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steps s WHERE s.project = l.project AND s.launch = l.step_launch) AS steps, l.step_launch AS launch FROM l WHERE l.issue_label = '${issue}' ORDER BY l.start_s, l.id
targets.queryText: WITH k AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(CAST(issue AS TEXT), 'orchestrator') AS issue_label, CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'orchestrator estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS lines, ':' || model || ':' || CASE WHEN estimate = 1 THEN 'estimate' ELSE 'measured' END AS sfx FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' AND provider IN ('claude', 'codex') AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER)), l AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(launch, CASE WHEN role = 'orchestrator' AND substr(id, 1, length(project) + 1) = project || ':' AND substr(id, -length(sfx)) = sfx THEN substr(id, length(project) + 2, length(id) - length(project) - 1 - length(sfx)) END) AS step_launch FROM k) SELECT l.start_time AS start, l.issue_label AS issue, l.role, l.provider, l.model, l.lines, l.retry, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, ROUND(l.seconds) AS seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steps s WHERE s.project = l.project AND s.launch = l.step_launch) AS steps, l.step_launch AS launch FROM l WHERE l.issue_label = '${issue}' ORDER BY l.start_s, l.id

panels.title: Steps of the launch
panels.description: The step rows of the chosen launch in `seq` order: tool, target, the four token kinds, duration and context size. Weighted tokens are an estimate from price ratios. Codex QA rows have no duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT seq, time, tool, target, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, ROUND(weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, duration_s, context_tokens, kit_doc, role FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND launch = '${launch}' AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) ORDER BY seq
targets.queryText: SELECT seq, time, tool, target, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, ROUND(weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, duration_s, context_tokens, kit_doc, role FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND launch = '${launch}' AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) ORDER BY seq

panels.title: Kit document reads
panels.description: Step rows of the stage that read a kit document (`kit_doc` not null), per role and document. The planner /stage-start session is left out.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT role, kit_doc, COUNT(*) AS reads FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND kit_doc IS NOT NULL AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) GROUP BY role, kit_doc ORDER BY role, kit_doc
targets.queryText: SELECT role, kit_doc, COUNT(*) AS reads FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND kit_doc IS NOT NULL AND NOT (role = 'planner' AND issue IS NULL) GROUP BY role, kit_doc ORDER BY role, kit_doc
